verdicts.evidence: `readFileSync(abs, "")`: an empty encoding is treated as no encoding and returns a Buffer, and `symbolPresent` tests it with a RegExp or `includes` after string coercion, which decodes it as UTF-8 — the same text as with "utf8". Coercing a Buffer to a string decodes it as UTF-8, so the text compared is the same whatever the file holds. Measured 2026-09-25: the symbol-resolution tests (present, renamed, unreadable directory) give identical results under the mutant.
